skills.name: Speech-to-Text
skills.description: Transcribes spoken audio into text with timestamps and speaker labels.
skills.trigger_condition: Audio file or recording needs transcription.
skills.boundary: Not for music or non-speech audio.

skills.name: Text-to-Speech
skills.description: Converts text into natural-sounding speech with voice selection.
skills.trigger_condition: User requests audio output from text.

skills.name: Audio-Classification
skills.description: Classifies audio segments into categories like speech, music, noise.
skills.trigger_condition: Audio content type detection needed.

skills.name: Sentiment-Detection
skills.description: Detects emotional tone and sentiment from speech audio.
skills.trigger_condition: Emotional analysis of spoken content needed.

skills.name: Workflow-Orchestration
skills.description: Manages multi-step automated workflows with branching, error handling, and retries.
skills.trigger_condition: Complex automated workflow needed.

skills.name: State-Monitoring
skills.description: Monitors system state, detects anomalies, and triggers alerts.
skills.trigger_condition: Continuous monitoring or anomaly detection needed.

skills.name: Self-Correction
skills.description: Detects and corrects errors in agent output through validation loops.
skills.trigger_condition: Output quality assurance needed.

skills.name: Tool-Selection
skills.description: Dynamically selects the best tool or API for a given subtask.
skills.trigger_condition: Multiple tools could serve the same subtask.
skills.boundary: Selection based on available tools only.

skills.name: Code-Generation
skills.description: Generates code in any language from natural language specifications.
skills.trigger_condition: User requests code creation or implementation.
skills.boundary: Always review generated code before execution.

skills.name: Code-Review
skills.description: Reviews code for bugs, security issues, performance, and best practices.
skills.trigger_condition: User submits code for review or quality check.
skills.boundary: Not a replacement for security audits.

skills.name: Code-Refactoring
skills.description: Improves code structure, readability, and maintainability without changing behavior.
skills.trigger_condition: Code needs cleanup or modernization.

skills.name: Testing
skills.description: Generates unit, integration, and e2e tests for code.
skills.trigger_condition: User needs test coverage for their code.
skills.boundary: Tests should be deterministic and isolated.

skills.name: Debugging
skills.description: Identifies and fixes bugs using error analysis and trace inspection.
skills.trigger_condition: User reports a bug or error in their code.
skills.boundary: May need runtime access for complex bugs.

skills.name: Documentation
skills.description: Generates technical documentation, API docs, and READMEs.
skills.trigger_condition: User needs documentation for their code or project.

skills.name: DevOps
skills.description: Manages CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure, and deployment configurations.
skills.trigger_condition: Deployment, infrastructure, or pipeline configuration needed.

skills.name: Security-Scanning
skills.description: Scans code for security vulnerabilities and compliance issues.
skills.trigger_condition: Security assessment of code needed.
skills.boundary: Not a replacement for penetration testing.

skills.name: LLM
skills.description: General text reasoning, generation, summarization, rewriting, and structured response synthesis.
skills.trigger_condition: Default for text-first tasks where no specialized modality is required.
skills.boundary: Do not use when a specialized modality is clearly required.
invoke_conditions: no media or specialized tool required

skills.name: Reasoning-Engine
skills.description: Performs multi-step logical analysis, constraint solving, and higher-difficulty decision support.
skills.trigger_condition: Complex planning or nontrivial logic chains requiring decomposition.
skills.boundary: Avoid for simple drafting or single-step generation.

skills.name: Planning
skills.description: Converts goals into ordered steps, milestones, dependencies, and execution phases.
skills.trigger_condition: User asks for roadmap, implementation sequence, or rollout strategy.
skills.boundary: Do not use as the final executor — plan only.

skills.name: Task-Decomposition
skills.description: Breaks large work into atomic subtasks with clear ownership and interfaces.
skills.trigger_condition: Multi-part work or large ambiguous requests needing structured breakdown.
skills.boundary: Not for final content generation alone.

skills.name: Chain-of-Thought-Control
skills.description: Enforces concise, bounded, non-leaky internal reasoning behavior and output discipline.
skills.trigger_condition: Sensitive, high-stakes, or token-limited tasks requiring disciplined trace management.
skills.boundary: Must not expose private reasoning traces externally.

skills.name: Memory-Short-Term
skills.description: Tracks immediate conversational state, active variables, and turn-local decisions.
skills.trigger_condition: Ongoing multi-step interaction requiring state carry-forward.
skills.boundary: Do not treat as durable memory — session-scoped only.

skills.name: Memory-Long-Term
skills.description: Stores stable user, project, or system preferences for future reuse across sessions.
skills.trigger_condition: Repeat workflows or user-specific continuity needing persistence.
skills.boundary: Avoid storing trivial or sensitive data without explicit need.

skills.name: Vector-Retrieval
skills.description: Retrieves semantically similar chunks from indexed knowledge bases using embedding similarity.
skills.trigger_condition: Contextual recall from documents or memory stores is required.
skills.boundary: Not for direct generation — retrieval and ranking only.

skills.name: RAG-Orchestration
skills.description: Combines retrieval, grounding, and answer synthesis into a citation-aware output flow.
skills.trigger_condition: Knowledge-backed answers requiring accuracy and source attribution.
skills.boundary: Avoid when no source base exists.

skills.name: Multi-Agent-Coordinator
skills.description: Assigns roles, routes subtasks, merges outputs, and resolves conflicts across agents.
skills.trigger_condition: Parallel or role-based multi-agent systems needing orchestration.
skills.boundary: Avoid for single-skill tasks — overhead not justified.

skills.name: Translation
skills.description: Translates text between languages with context awareness.
skills.trigger_condition: Multi-language translation needed.
skills.boundary: Not for specialized legal or medical translation.

skills.name: Summarization
skills.description: Creates concise summaries of long documents or conversations.
skills.trigger_condition: Content needs condensing while preserving key points.
skills.boundary: May miss nuance in highly technical content.

skills.name: Classification
skills.description: Classifies text into predefined or discovered categories.
skills.trigger_condition: Content categorization needed.

skills.name: Entity-Extraction
skills.description: Extracts named entities (people, places, orgs, dates) from text.
skills.trigger_condition: Structured data extraction from unstructured text needed.

skills.name: Email-Drafting
skills.description: Drafts professional emails with appropriate tone and structure.
skills.trigger_condition: Email composition assistance needed.

skills.name: Meeting-Notes
skills.description: Generates structured meeting notes with action items and decisions.
skills.trigger_condition: Meeting transcript or notes need processing.

skills.name: Presentation-Builder
skills.description: Creates slide deck outlines and content from topics or data.
skills.trigger_condition: Presentation creation needed.

skills.name: Math-Solver
skills.description: Solves mathematical problems with step-by-step explanations.
skills.trigger_condition: Mathematical computation or proof needed.
skills.boundary: Not for approximate or statistical problems.

skills.name: Competitive-Analysis
skills.description: Analyzes competitors, market positioning, and strategic opportunities.
skills.trigger_condition: Market or competitive analysis needed.
skills.boundary: Based on available public information only.

skills.name: Risk-Assessment
skills.description: Identifies, evaluates, and prioritizes risks with mitigation strategies.
skills.trigger_condition: Risk evaluation for a project or decision needed.
skills.boundary: Not a legal or financial advisory.

skills.name: Decision-Framework
skills.description: Structures complex decisions using frameworks like SWOT, decision trees, and weighted scoring.
skills.trigger_condition: Complex decision requiring structured analysis.
skills.boundary: Framework-based — final judgment remains with user.

skills.name: Compliance-Check
skills.description: Reviews content or processes against regulatory and policy requirements.
skills.trigger_condition: Compliance verification needed.

skills.name: Business-Writing
skills.description: Writes business documents: proposals, reports, memos, and presentations.
skills.trigger_condition: Professional business document needed.

skills.name: Token-Management
skills.description: Tracks and optimizes token usage across model calls.
skills.trigger_condition: Token budget management needed.

skills.name: Error-Recovery
skills.description: Handles errors, retries failed operations, and provides fallback paths.
skills.trigger_condition: Operation failure needing graceful recovery.

skills.name: Context-Window-Management
skills.description: Manages context window size through summarization and prioritization.
skills.trigger_condition: Context exceeds available window.

skills.name: Logging
skills.description: Records system events, decisions, and outputs for debugging and audit.
skills.trigger_condition: Audit trail or debugging information needed.

skills.name: Cache-Management
skills.description: Caches and retrieves frequently used results to reduce latency and cost.
skills.trigger_condition: Repeated queries or computations detected.

skills.name: Skill-Registry-Manifest
skills.description: Returns the complete categorized catalog of available SkillHub skills as a structured manifest for external agents (e.g. Sophie).
skills.trigger_condition: When an external agent asks "what skills are available?" or requests a capability index/manifest/catalog.
skills.boundary: Read-only — returns only registry metadata, never invokes downstream skills.

skills.name: UI-Design
skills.description: Creates UI component designs, layouts, and visual hierarchies.
skills.trigger_condition: User needs UI design for a feature or page.

skills.name: UX-Research
skills.description: Analyzes user behavior, conducts heuristic evaluations, and identifies usability issues.
skills.trigger_condition: User experience assessment or improvement needed.

skills.name: Copywriting
skills.description: Writes UI copy, microcopy, error messages, and marketing text.
skills.trigger_condition: Text content needed for interfaces or marketing.

skills.name: Accessibility-Audit
skills.description: Evaluates interfaces for WCAG compliance and accessibility issues.
skills.trigger_condition: Accessibility review needed.

skills.name: Design-System
skills.description: Creates and maintains design tokens, component libraries, and style guides.
skills.trigger_condition: Design system creation or update needed.

skills.name: VLM
skills.description: Understands images/screenshots and answers questions about visual content.
skills.trigger_condition: User asks to inspect, analyze, or interpret an image.
skills.boundary: Do not use for image creation or generation.

skills.name: Image-Generation
skills.description: Creates new images from prompts, references, or art direction.
skills.trigger_condition: User requests visual creation from scratch.
skills.boundary: Avoid when analysis of an existing image is needed.

skills.name: Image-Editing
skills.description: Modifies an existing image by adding, removing, or restyling elements.
skills.trigger_condition: User requests changes to an uploaded image.
skills.boundary: Do not use when a brand-new image is better suited.

skills.name: Image-Upscaling
skills.description: Enhances image resolution and perceived detail.
skills.trigger_condition: Existing image is too small or blurry for intended use.
skills.boundary: Do not promise true lost-detail recovery.

skills.name: Image-Classification
skills.description: Labels or categorizes an image into known classes.
skills.trigger_condition: Fast category or content-type detection needed.

skills.name: Object-Detection
skills.description: Finds and locates objects within an image with bounding boxes.
skills.trigger_condition: Spatial detection or counting of objects needed.

skills.name: OCR
skills.description: Extracts text from images, screenshots, and scanned documents.
skills.trigger_condition: Text extraction from visual media.
skills.boundary: Not for handwriting recognition in difficult cases.

skills.name: Video-Analysis
skills.description: Analyzes video content for scene detection, object tracking, and event recognition.
skills.trigger_condition: User submits video for analysis.

skills.name: Web-Search
skills.description: Searches the web for real-time information and returns relevant results.
skills.trigger_condition: User needs current or factual information not in training data.
skills.boundary: Not for generating content — retrieval only.

skills.name: Web-Scraping
skills.description: Extracts structured data from web pages and APIs.
skills.trigger_condition: User needs data from a specific URL or website.

skills.name: Data-Analysis
skills.description: Analyzes datasets with statistical methods, pattern detection, and visualization.
skills.trigger_condition: User provides data for analysis or asks analytical questions.

skills.name: Data-Transformation
skills.description: Converts, cleans, and reshapes data between formats.
skills.trigger_condition: Data needs reformatting or cleaning.

skills.name: API-Integration
skills.description: Calls external APIs with proper authentication and error handling.
skills.trigger_condition: Integration with third-party service needed.

skills.name: PDF-Processing
skills.description: Extracts text, tables, and metadata from PDF documents.
skills.trigger_condition: PDF document needs parsing.

skills.name: Spreadsheet-Processing
skills.description: Reads, writes, and manipulates spreadsheet data.
skills.trigger_condition: Spreadsheet operations needed.
